evidence_stages.lead: Candidate lead only; not a dossier and not decision evidence.
evidence_stages.source_logic: Minimum dossier stage for decisions; representative implementation files and runtime logic have been inspected.
evidence_stages.benchmark_audit: Benchmark harness, task set, scoring, token accounting, raw outputs, and failure/exclusion semantics have been inspected.
evidence_stages.reproduction: Independent target-workload reproduction with provider-billed usage, pass rate, turn count, latency, and quality gates.
